paragraphs: Academia by Serosoft sells a student information system to educational institutions. The company frames the product around student and administrative experiences. A reviewer quoted on the site describes an ERP whose features cover admissions, academics, finance and HR.

Access is pitched as open to all stakeholders across multiple platforms and browsers. Reporting is a large part of the offer, counted at more than 800 reports and data visualizations. A workflow and rules engine is meant to eliminate repetitive administrative tasks. That automation extends to notifications, deadlines, approvals and data validation. The company claims automating administrative work reduces staff hours on routine tasks by 25 to 40 percent. It also says the system integrates with other software already used in an institution.

The company puts its reach at over a million learners worldwide. It says the product was recognized by Gartner in the Magic Quadrant for Student Information System SaaS in 2025. Named reviewers include an acting deputy principal at a TVET college. The footer carries a 2026 copyright for Academia by Serosoft.
